sources.excerpt: Suns Ultravoid Fuzz by Keeley Electronics | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Keeley Electronics Suns Ultravoid Fuzz LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description Building upon Keeley’s fan-favorite Moon fuzz pedal, the Keeley Suns Ultravoid tweaks and refines the formula of its lauded lunar predecessor — and you can only get it at Sweetwater! Armed with a simple control set — Level, Filter, and Fuzz — this pedal’s redesigned tone stack provides a tighter low-end response, resulting in a tone that’s sharper and more focused than the original Moon. In addition, the reactive clipping LED elevates your every note into the stratosphere with a lively, harmonic-rich, and dynamic feel. Made in the USA right along with the rest of Keeley’s boutique-level stompbox creations, the Keeley Suns Ultravoid unleashes a searing set of blazing fuzz sounds to explore.
